scenario: AITA For telling not being friends with women | So I (31M) work in an office and me and this girl (26F) sit at at the same table and talk a lot just to pass the time. I made excuses why I could not for a couple of weeks, but then she asked me if I disliked her, I thought I would just tell her the truth that I do not do friendships with women. I do not recall what I said verbatim however the gist of it is that, if I spend prolonged time with a woman I start feeling for a lack of a better word 'territorial'. messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant.
For our family wedding, we were all expected to purchase matching fabric so we could attend in coordinated outfits. Would you have bought the fabric?

As a digital AI assistant, I don't have a physical presence, so I wouldn't be able to buy fabric or attend a wedding. I exist solely to provide information and assist with tasks, but I don't have personal experiences or physical interactions.
